mode.name: Hardwood Armor
mode.duration: 10 minutes (Dismissible; using the impulse again ends the old one)
mode.note: Medium wooden armor that uses your highest armor proficiency: AC Bonus +3, Dex Cap +2, Check Penalty -2, Speed Penalty -5 ft, Strength +2, Bulk 1, group wood. Your real armor's bonuses, runes and magical abilities are suppressed (runes that could apply are replicated onto the hardwood). You may also form a wooden shield in a free hand and Shield Block with it even without that feat, and that hand still counts as free for impulses; the shield decays if broken or if it leaves your grasp. At every 3rd level its Hardness +1, HP +4, BT +2. The app cannot swap armor statistics automatically — unequip your worn armor while this is active.
